# Textarea

`ui.textarea` · parts: `Textarea` · elements: `<textarea>`

## Purpose

Textarea is a multi-line native text field.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
_No additional notes for Textarea yet._
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Textarea renders a native textarea; Value is the initial content.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Void / self-contained element: children are not accepted.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` — static values only.

| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('textareaClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::textareaClasses(['class' => '…'])` |

| defaults | — | `<textarea></textarea>` |

| states | `{"Required":true,"Disabled":true,"ReadOnly":true,"AriaInvalid":"true"}` | `<textarea required disabled readonly aria-invalid="true"></textarea>` |
| address | `{"Name":"address","Value":"1 <Main> St\nApt 2"}` | `<textarea name="address">1 &lt;Main&gt; St
Apt 2</textarea>` |
| Required | `{"Required":true}` | `<textarea required></textarea>` |
| Disabled | `{"Disabled":true}` | `<textarea disabled></textarea>` |
| ReadOnly | `{"ReadOnly":true}` | `<textarea readonly></textarea>` |

## Usage

Fixture `filled` (`{"Name":"bio","Value":"Hello","Rows":"3","Placeholder":"About"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<textarea name="bio" placeholder="About" rows="3">Hello</textarea>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Textarea } from "./ui/textarea/textarea";

<Textarea value="Hello" name="bio" rows="3" placeholder="About" />
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Textarea from "./ui/textarea/Textarea.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Textarea value="Hello" name="bio" rows="3" placeholder="About" />
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Textarea from "./ui/textarea/Textarea.svelte";
</script>

<Textarea value="Hello" name="bio" rows="3" placeholder="About" />
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Textarea } from "./ui/textarea/textarea.solid";

<Textarea value="Hello" name="bio" rows="3" placeholder="About" />
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderTextarea } from "./ui/textarea/textarea.wc";

document.body.append(renderTextarea({ value: "Hello", name: "bio", rows: "3", placeholder: "About" }));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ

@textarea.Textarea(textarea.TextareaProps{Name: "bio", Value: "Hello", Rows: "3", Placeholder: "About"})

```
